wins: Captured detailed service/banner information during initial reconnaissance (ep001_step02) which provides actionable hypotheses for later exploitation.
Successfully enumerated open ports and correlated service versions with known vulnerabilities, enabling a prioritized target list (ep001_step05).
fails: Unable to develop and execute a stable privilege escalation path despite multiple mentor interventions (ep001_step08).
Failed to achieve mission success within allotted episode time, resulting in a 0% success rate despite incremental progress.
key_outcomes.summary: The agent demonstrated reliable reconnaissance behaviors and target triage but repeatedly stalled during exploitation and privilege escalation, preventing overall success.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation attempts stalled due to missing credential harvesting and ineffective use of discovered services

skill_cards.if_condition: When port scanning reveals HTTP/SSH banners from open ports
skill_cards.then_action: Capture banner text and map to known service versions with the vulnerability database

skill_cards.if_condition: When multiple open ports detected during initial sweep
skill_cards.then_action: Prioritize exploitation pathway based on service-criticality and CVSS data

skill_cards.if_condition: When service version identified for target host
skill_cards.then_action: Cross-reference service version with known CVEs and document potential payloads

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in extracting actionable reconnaissance data
